comments.text:
Wire integral-core's DeviceState into the nih-plug plugin's process loop.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.3 (MidiBridge trait), i7-49c.4 (nih-plug skeleton)

IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Create a VstMidiBridge struct implementing the MidiBridge trait from i7-49c.3
2. In the plugin's process() callback:
   - Feed incoming SysEx to DeviceState.handle_dt1()
   - Call DeviceState.drain() on each process block, send outgoing SysEx via NoteEvent
   - Use the block's timestamp for throttle timing
3. Store DeviceState in an Arc<Mutex<>> shared between the process thread and the editor
4. Implement initial state loading: on plugin load, queue RQ1 requests for all mixer parameters (same sequence as web/src/useMixer.ts loadState())

ARCHITECTURE:
- process() runs on the audio thread — keep it lock-free where possible
- The editor (Vizia) reads state from a shared reference
- Parameter changes from the editor queue DT1 messages via DeviceState
- The process() callback drains and sends them

REFERENCE:
- web/src/useMixer.ts lines 145-275: loadState() sequence (what to request on init)
- web/src/integra.ts: drain loop timing, request/response pairing

title: VST: wire integral-core DeviceState into nih-plug processing
